issues.evidence: Heading level inversion: h2 ('0 notifications total') and h3 ('Ajit Mallavarapu') appear in DOM before h1 ('feed updates'). Repeated h2 'Skip to LinkedIn News' (7+ instances) used as structural skip links rather than section headings — no unique labels. Page title has '(11)' notification-count prefix that is a browser artifact.

listStyleNone=7: seven ul/ol elements use list-style:none without role='list'. In Safari+VoiceOver these lists will lose their list semantics. Chrome shows them correctly but VoiceOver users are affected.
Comment button box 71x18px — height 18px is below the 24px touch target minimum (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8).
Info icon button box 16x19px — both dimensions below the 24px touch target minimum (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8). Axe target-size rule flags similar patterns.

Button axName='Show more' — generic label that does not describe what additional content will be shown. In context of LinkedIn News aside, provides minimal guidance on purpose beyond 'show more news'.

Link axName='Mini Sudoku Mini Sudoku #224 19 connections played' — 'Mini Sudoku' is duplicated in the accessible name, resulting in awkward SR announcement. The name composition error reflects a labelling implementation issue.

Post image with alt='No alternative text description for this image' — this is LinkedIn's auto-generated placeholder, not a real description. SR announces the placeholder text rather than image content, providing no useful information.

For Business, Show more (LinkedIn News), Open control menu, and info button: dropdown/popup activation could not be exercised in the saved page. Static ARIA wiring (aria-expanded, popup role) is present but announcement of state change could not be confirmed.

axe link-name: link a[data-control-id='E3tefn6gSSGalk+nZ8mJWQ=='] has no discernible text — unnamed link in the feed. This element was not in the sampled 21 but is flagged by axe as a genuine 4.1.2/2.4.4 failure.
